problem_statement: ChatHN is a compact Next.js App Router AI chat app whose homepage turns natural-language Hacker News questions into OpenAI Function calls. The app now ships a Prompt library: its own command browser that lets a visitor filter the eight example prompts by the Hacker News surface each one drives (Stories, Comments, Search) and send one straight into the chat. Build the Prompt library so it is a consistent, native part of ChatHN: the same category tab bar, live result readout, and prompt-card grid render on the chat landing, on the dedicated /examples route, and on the /about page; selecting a category filters the cards live and updates the readout to match; the prompt cards stay legible ChatHN cards; and the tab bar and card grid wrap on a 390px phone so the chat landing never overflows horizontally. Ground every prompt card in ChatHN's own visual language — the light example-panel card surface, the green accent, the monospace function-token chip, and the small type rhythm — so the captured desktop, tablet, and mobile states read as a native ChatHN screen rather than a bolted-on widget.
required_content: A Prompt library command browser renders the eight example prompts as legible cards (title, the OpenAI function each prompt drives such as get_top_stories or summarize_top_story, a category chip, and a blurb), grouped by category tabs All prompts / Stories / Comments / Search, with a live readout that reads 'Showing all 8 prompts' before any filter.

The Prompt library appears as the same shared component on the chat landing, on the /examples route, and on the /about page, and a 'Prompt library' nav link is present in the top navigation on every route (cross-page command surface).

Selecting a category tab filters the prompt cards live and updates the readout to the current selection (for example clicking Comments shows 'Showing 3 of 8 · Comments' and displays the three comment prompts).

The prompt cards keep legible contrast and a wrapping responsive grid, so on a 390px mobile viewport the tab bar and card grid fit within the screen (no_horizontal_overflow within 24px tolerance) while desktop keeps its multi-column grid; the ChatHN welcome card, message composer, and footer links are not regressed.
design_constraints: Reuse ChatHN's own visual language: the light example-panel card surface (white cards on the gray #f9fafb panel), the green #16a34a accent, thin #e5e7eb divider rules, monospace function tokens, and small type rhythm; the Prompt library must read as a native ChatHN surface, not a bolted-on widget.

The prompt cards must stay legible: near-black #111827 titles and readable #4b5563 blurb text on white cards, visible category chips; they must not collapse into an unreadable dark-on-dark palette or overlap each other with negative margins.
The prompt copy and the function each prompt maps to must match ChatHN's real OpenAI Function schema (get_top_stories, get_story, get_story_with_comments, summarize_top_story).

The category tab bar, the live readout, and the prompt-card grid must be identical markup wherever the library appears (chat landing, /examples, /about); a library that only renders on the chat landing breaks the cross-page command-browser invariant.
The tab bar and prompt-card grid must wrap on a 390px phone; a fixed-width non-wrapping track (masked with overflow-x:hidden on the grid) still overflows the document and is not a fix.

The category tabs must re-read the clicked tab on each click and re-filter the visible cards, updating the readout live; a handler that only toggles the active pill but leaves the readout and cards stale is not acceptable.
Do not regress the Welcome to ChatHN card, the message composer, or the footer links; introduce no new framework, dependency, or remote asset.
state_constraints: desktop_initial, mobile_initial, and tablet_initial verify the chat landing renders the Welcome to ChatHN card, the fixed message composer, the shared top nav with the registered 'Prompt library' nav-link, and the Prompt library command browser with its eight legible prompt cards.

desktop_home_explorer and mobile_home_explorer verify the Prompt library renders on the chat landing on-palette with legible prompt cards (title, function token, category chip, blurb) and a wrapping tab bar / card grid.
desktop_examples and mobile_examples verify the /examples route renders the SAME shared Prompt library (eight prompt cards, tab bar, readout) with the shared nav (cross-page invariant).
desktop_about verifies the /about route also renders the shared Prompt library beneath its blurb, with the 'Prompt library' nav-link present.
desktop_filter_comments verifies that clicking the 'Comments' category tab filters the visible cards and updates the readout to 'Showing 3 of 8 · Comments'.

change_completion: The shared Prompt library renders on the chat landing, the /examples route, and the /about route with the eyebrow, title 'Browse ChatHN's example prompts', the category tab bar, the readout, and the eight prompt cards.

Each prompt card shows the correct OpenAI function token (get_top_stories, get_story, get_story_with_comments, or summarize_top_story) and category chip, and the readout reads 'Showing all 8 prompts' before any filter and updates to the selected category after a tab click.
design_consistency: The Prompt library matches ChatHN's light card palette, green #16a34a accent, thin dividers, and card treatment on every route, with legible near-black card text (not dark-on-dark) and non-overlapping cards.
A 'Prompt library' nav-link is registered in the shared top navigation and renders on every route; the Welcome card, composer, and footer links remain visually intact.
responsive: On a 390px mobile viewport the Prompt library tab bar and prompt-card grid wrap cleanly so the chat landing has no horizontal overflow (within 24px tolerance).
Desktop and tablet keep the multi-column prompt-card grid with no horizontal overflow on any captured state.
regression: The Welcome to ChatHN card copy, the message composer form, and the footer links (OpenAI Functions, Vercel AI SDK, View the repo, deploy your own) remain present and unchanged.
No new dependency, framework, remote asset, or route system is introduced, and no console or network errors are emitted on any captured state.

author_notes: Native lever for the chathn (ChatHN) AI chat app: the Prompt library is the app's own command browser of example prompts, a real conversation-surface control rather than a decorative rail. The prompt cards, category filter, live readout, and cross-route consistency exercise design continuity, an interactive filter, credible legibility/layout defects, and mobile responsiveness. Prompt copy is grounded in ChatHN's real OpenAI Function schema.
